outcome_blind_inputs: canonical sentence corpus_id, sent_id, and doc_path
canonical feature sent_id, token_count, and char_count
outcomes_not_inspected_before_freeze: raw or adjusted corpus score contrasts
estimand: For each original/strict variant and corpus, the mean observed SpeciTeller score standardized to an equally weighted four-corpus token-count distribution over exact token counts satisfying common-support thresholds in that variant.

reference_distribution.definition: Within common support, normalize each corpus token-count distribution to sum to one, then take the unweighted arithmetic mean of the four corpus-specific probabilities at every exact token count.

weights.normalization: weights sum to the corpus common-support row count, and weighted means equal direct exact-stratum standardization
weights.action_if_exceeded: fail the analysis rather than silently cap weights or change the target distribution
diagnostics: support loss by corpus and variant

primary_uncertainty.method: nonparametric document-cluster bootstrap within each corpus

regression_sensitivity.analysis_rows: same variant-specific exact common-support rows as primary standardization
regression_sensitivity.model: ordinary least squares of score on corpus indicators and a five-knot restricted cubic spline of log(token_count)
regression_sensitivity.knot_source: variant-specific equally weighted four-corpus reference distribution
regression_sensitivity.uncertainty: CR1 document-cluster-robust sandwich covariance with doc_path clusters nested within corpus
regression_sensitivity.reported_contrasts: Wikipedia minus each technical corpus; additive model contrasts and interaction-model length-specific contrasts
regression_sensitivity.character_count: not included in the primary or token-regression model; any character-count analysis must be labeled a separate robustness model

interaction_diagnostic.model: add corpus-by-restricted-cubic-spline interactions to the frozen additive model
interaction_diagnostic.evaluation_token_counts: variant-specific reference-distribution quantiles at probabilities 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 0.90
interaction_diagnostic.substantial_if: For any Wikipedia-to-technical contrast, the maximum minus minimum point contrast across evaluation counts is at least 0.10 score units, or the point contrasts change sign.
additional_diagnostics: interaction-model partial R-squared relative to additive model
interaction_diagnostic.reporting_rule: Always export length-specific contrasts; if substantial, categorize the affected variant/contrast as heterogeneous rather than summarize it only by one additive adjusted effect.

categorization.heterogeneous: interaction diagnostic is substantial for the contrast
categorization.reversed: standardized point gap has the opposite sign from the raw point gap and its 95% interval excludes zero
categorization.eliminated: standardized 95% interval includes zero or the absolute standardized point gap is below 0.02
categorization.attenuated: same-sign non-eliminated standardized gap has absolute magnitude below 80% of the raw gap
categorization.persistent: same-sign non-eliminated standardized gap retains at least 80% of the raw gap
categorization.language_boundary: Categories describe observed SpeciTeller score differences after measured length adjustment; they are not causal domain-effect labels.
